title: Decision-Making Practice and Review
learningObjectives: Explain decision-making practice and review in C++ decision logic.
Identify the condition and the branch paths it controls.
Trace execution for normal, boundary and unexpected values.
Write clear and correct decision statements for a practical case.
Review common mistakes such as ordering, nesting or missing fallback handling.

understand.concept: Decision logic combines conditions, branches and validation. Plan the cases, identify boundaries, order overlapping conditions carefully, and test ordinary, boundary and invalid inputs.
understand.whyItMatters: Decision logic controls program behavior. Correct conditions, branch order, fallback paths and validation keep programs predictable and robust.
understand.explain: Use the examples to trace decision-making practice and review; identify which branch is reached for each test input and explain why other branches are skipped.

practise.guidedTask: Trace all five decision-making practice and review examples. For each, record the condition outcome and executed branch. Change one input to test an alternate path.
practise.independentTask: Write a small C++ decision-based program applying decision-making practice and review to a realistic scenario. Test at least three normal cases, two boundary cases and one invalid/unexpected case.
hints: Write the condition in plain language before coding.
Trace the branch that runs for each sample value.
Keep nesting shallow and branches explicit.
Include a fallback or validation path when appropriate.
